description: Add or change a Greenhouse Agent profile. First decide whether a system preset is needed at all: most requests are a custom Agent (run_profiles row), a profile pack, a plugin's agent context or a sprouty.yaml edit. When a preset really is needed: YAML in apps/api/src/profiles, profile.ts constants, agent-profiles.md, the guard test and the client's hard-coded ids move together. Use for: add an agent / new profile / new assistant / change the system prompt, 加个 agent, 新增 profile, 做个新助手, 改系统提示词. Red lines: access is only level + rich_output, no options or extends in YAML, built-in YAML uses tools: [], prompts never restate dynamic tool rules.
